operator.name: VideoFileWriterOp
operator.description: FFmpeg-backed encoder operator. Consumes holoscan::Tensor frames (NHWC or NCHW; uint8 or float; RGB, BGR, or grayscale) and writes them to an .mp4 (or any libavformat-supported container) via libavcodec. Defaults to the mpeg4 encoder (shipped with every stock FFmpeg build) regardless of container; override via the writer's codec config entry to select libx264, libx265, mjpeg, or ffv1 — those require an FFmpeg build with the matching encoder enabled.
